title: Structured Factorization Approaches for Quantum State Tomography
summary: Since the complexity of quantum state tomography (QST) scales exponentially with system size, exploiting priors such as low-rankness, tensor-network structures, and neural-network representations is essential for scalable QST in terms of sample complexity and parameter complexity. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework, termed structured factorization, that builds on BurerMonteiro-type factorization by parametrizing the density matrix as $FF^\dagger$, where the factor $F$ is constrained to belong to a structured model class.
